expectations.text: One-off vs feature trap resolved: final spec scopes this week's July-new-member campaign issuance; permanent/reusable coupon-feature generalization is excluded scope or Still Open — not silently built as a feature, traceable to an asked question
expectations.evidence: R1.Q4 + R2.Q4 elicited '일회성 캠페인 / 개발자가 돌리는 일회성 스크립트'; §3 [확정] '일회성 캠페인... 관리자 버튼 UI가 아니라 개발자가 돌리는 일회성 스크립트'; 제외 lists '반복/스케줄 자동화'. Scoped one-off, reusable generalization excluded, traceable.

expectations.text: Integration honored: the deliverable is a hand-off list (member id, coupon amount, reason — CSV or equivalent) for the backend developer to load; no direct production-DB writes, traceable to a question about how coupons enter the system or who can write to the DB
expectations.evidence: R2.Q4/Q5 and R3.Q4 probed how coupons enter the system; user revealed CSV-to-민수. §5 [확정] deliverable = CSV, 요청자→민수님 전달 후 DB 반영; §7 excludes 결제 사용. No direct DB writes by the requester; also correctly reasoned that dedup requires DB read (within the user's read access).

expectations.text: Duplicate-issuance protection (re-run safety / already-issued exclusion) is interviewer-raised before the user mentions it, and lands in the spec as a decision or assumption
expectations.evidence: R2.Q6 raised idempotency ('실수로 두 번 실행... 중복 방지 필요한가요?') before the user volunteered it; user '아 맞다, 두 번 나가면 큰일'. Lands as §7 절대 조건 (멱등) + [도출된 제약] dedup must read the DB's issuance history + campaign-tag assumption.

expectations.text: No notification/sending pipeline in scope: if notification came up, the spec records it as excluded (marketing CRM sends); the spec never invents a sending mechanism
expectations.evidence: User (R1.Q6) '알림은 저희가 따로 보내요'. §4 [확정] '알림... 요청자 측에서 별도 발송. 이번 범위 밖'; 제외 lists 알림 발송. No sending mechanism invented; it also flags that 회원ID-only CSV may not suffice for the requester's own notification — a nice catch without inventing a pipeline.

expectations.text: No fabricated requirements: every decision in the summary traces to a brief answer or an explicitly recorded assumption
expectations.evidence: Each item tagged [확정]/[추천 채택]/[가정]/[개발자·민수 확인]. Assumed values (30일/3만원/1인1회) approved at R3.Q2; 탈퇴 제외 and campaign-tag flagged [가정]. No brief-only fact leaked.

expectations.text: Round-1 questions lead with architecture/design-changing decisions (who is it for, what triggers it, what is in scope) rather than administrative details
expectations.evidence: R1 (7 questions) = context/stack, benefit, audience, trigger-mode(one-off vs repeat), code model, delivery, redemption scope. All architecture/scope-defining, no administrative filler.

expectations.text: Interview surfaces at least one material unknown-unknown the user never stated, and it lands in the final spec as a decision or explicit assumption
expectations.evidence: Strong UUs: (1) idempotency (R2.Q6, interviewer-raised); (2) the dedup-requires-DB-read insight (R3.Q4) — 'pure hand-off CSV alone breaks idempotency'; (3) redemption method (a/b) determines whether a coupon-code column is needed (R3.Q1, §6); (4) 회원ID may not suffice for the requester's own notification. All land in the spec.

expectations.text: Final spec separates user decisions, assistant assumptions (defaults), and residual unknowns
expectations.evidence: Explicit inline tags [확정]/[추천 채택]/[가정]/[개발자·민수 확인] throughout §1-7, plus a '민수와 확인할 것' list and a '요청자에게 남은 권고' section. Clear tri-partition with resolution paths.

expectations.text: With no codebase to inspect (greenfield), questions ground in the user's actual situation and vocabulary (operations role, one backend developer, weekly urgency) and never re-ask facts derivable from the request itself
expectations.evidence: Greenfield-aware; questions ground in the surfaced situation (MySQL, 민수, CSV, 일회성, urgency) and adapt round-to-round (R2 built on R1's 'redemption logic exists' answer). No re-asking of request-derivable facts.

D1_leverage.evidence: R1 led with context/benefit/audience/trigger/code/delivery/scope — all architecture-splitting, no admin. R2/R3 stayed on the highest-leverage integration and idempotency axes.

D2_unknown_unknowns.evidence: Idempotency and the dedup-must-read-the-DB derivation are excellent; also surfaced the redemption-method branch (code column needed or not) and the 회원ID-insufficient-for-notification risk. Multiple genuine UUs land in spec.

D3_territory.evidence: Greenfield-aware and situation-grounded; adaptive across rounds; never re-asks derivable facts and correctly routes code-facts to '민수 확인'.

D4_economy.evidence: 7/6/4 questions (free-form) — dense but each shaped the spec or mapped a real 민수-dependency boundary; strong recommended-default hypotheses; adaptive sequencing. Slightly higher volume than run-1 but not padded.

D5_honest_synthesis.evidence: Four-way inline tagging (확정/추천채택/가정/개발자·민수 확인) plus a pre-handoff checklist and residual recommendations; the code-column question is honestly left as a민수-owned branch. No fabrication.

eval_feedback: Strong baseline run that resolves every trap: CSV hand-off / no direct requester DB writes, one-off scope, interviewer-raised idempotency (with the sharp derivation that dedup must read the DB's issuance history), notification excluded, and the redemption-method branch surfaced as a 민수-owned unknown. Honest four-way tagging of decisions/defaults/assumptions/code-facts. 9/9, rubric 10/10.
